subject: Microsoft updating Rattle to support out-of-memory (i.e. big) data and parallel processing

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Microsoft updating Rattle to support out-of-memory (i.e. big) data and parallel processing
parts:
See this recent blog post for some current contributions to Rattle from Microsoft.

https://blogs.msdn.microsoft.com/rserver/2017/04/14/microsoft-r-server-support-for-rattle/

Microsoft R Server is not open source software but is widely used in industry where larger size data handling is required.

Microsoft R Client is a free but closed source limited functionality version for testing.
